## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.0-beta.10 keeps very large project-scoped MCP graph lookups responsive by answering from ready code context before a background refresh begins.

Threadnote 5 helps agents begin with focused, cited code context. This beta makes large project-scoped MCP reads more dependable when the graph needs to refresh.

### Start with the code context already ready

For a project scope spanning many workspace components, Threadnote now answers from the compatible ready graph before it starts background refresh work. Agents can keep investigating the project they selected without waiting for a full scope inventory to be prepared again.

When fresher code context is ready, later work uses it automatically. Threadnote still keeps scope boundaries intact, so focused results remain tied to the project you configured.
